# localhost

> git hosting on Cloudflare for people and their agents. Durable Objects hold the repositories, D1 holds the metadata, R2 holds the big blobs.

- [Skill](https://localhost.wgw.lol/skill.md): how an agent authenticates and uses the API and git.
- [auth.md](https://localhost.wgw.lol/auth.md): agentic registration (anonymous claim ceremony).
- [API index](https://localhost.wgw.lol/api): machine-readable list of endpoints.
- [OAuth metadata](https://localhost.wgw.lol/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server): token, device, and revocation endpoints.
